policy.timing: Named ordered excerpt clock deltas only; equal per-stop interpolation between anchors. Gaps use FULL988 median route/direction total / reference legs, else ordered excerpt span / span legs. Unjoined internal coarse totals require a source family candidate and identical listed direction origin; this calibrates a model only, not a stop/departure join or a measured variant duration. First-pass missing duration stays null in evidence_legs; no reverse, midnight unwrap or loop clock reset inferred.

agency_prior.description: Fill only null legs using the median of mean seconds per reference leg from first-pass complete variants of the same agency, equally weighted per variant. No same-agency donor means null. Donors may themselves include modelled gaps. Not route-specific evidence, published timing, measured travel or geographic accuracy; anchor conflicts and departure joins remain unchanged.

policy.precision: Integer seconds are arithmetic estimates, not sub-minute accuracy or geography claims. All derived legs are estimated/modelled, never published passage or measured Moovit travel.
policy.joins: Explicit source candidate families + normalized origin + ordered shared named anchors; partial named alignment is provisional, not proof of all served stops or vehicle continuity.
policy.normalization: Case/Greek diacritics/whitespace only; explicit Syros KTEL locality aliases; no fuzzy, address truncation, generic-stop identity or municipal/port equivalence.

source_observations.route_name: Αγορά → Καρνάγιο → Άγιος Παντελεήμων → Καμίνια → Αγορά
Αγορά → Λαλακιά → Ανάσταση → Βροντάδος → Νεάπολη → Αθλητικό Κέντρο → Αγορά

traffic_model_guidance.baseline_stop_times: Use verified schedule or licensed historical profile with provenance as anchors; avoid assuming it is GPS history
traffic_model_guidance.eta_rule: ETA_j = BASE_T_j + CUM_SUM(actual_segment_travel - baseline_segment_travel) + CUM_SUM(actual_dwell - baseline_dwell), adjusted for now-position and monotonic continuity
traffic_model_guidance.interpolation: Between anchors distribute baseline duration by canonical path distance/curvature/limits and physics; do not force physically impossible travel
traffic_model_guidance.propagation: Apply traffic delta downstream once, permit bounded natural delay recovery only if unrestricted physical capacity, respect speed/curve caps
traffic_model_guidance.dwell: Where arrival/departure dwell unavailable mark uncertainty; no double counting a typical stop hold already included in baseline
traffic_model_guidance.traffic_source: Independent OSM/local profiles; not Google Maps TrafficLayer visual signal; do not enable Google Routes
traffic_model_guidance.cache: One effective motion plan per trip/version, shared across positions and stop arrivals; lock and benchmark concurrent requests
traffic_model_guidance.precision: Minute-resolution public timetable does not justify sub-minute accuracy or platform precision
traffic_model_guidance.source_label: VIRTUAL_SCHEDULE or VIRTUAL_REALTIME simulated, never PHYSICAL/LIVE_GPS without actual telematics
